claims.text: NASA's history office dates the programme's public and classified halves: announced by Defense Secretary Robert S. McNamara in December 1963, formally approved by President Johnson in August 1965, 17 pilots selected in three groups on 12 November 1965, 17 June 1966 and 30 June 1967, flown on the Titan-IIIM from Vandenberg into polar orbit, cancelled 10 June 1969, and 'not declassified by the NRO until October 2015'.
